description: This file defines the BatchDelete class used for batch deletion of objects from Amazon S3, including methods for creating batch delete operations from list results or iterators, and managing asynchronous deletion promises.

classes.name: BatchDelete
classes.description: A class providing functionality to delete multiple objects from Amazon S3 efficiently, supporting both list and iterator sources, with asynchronous capabilities.

methods.name: fromListObjects
methods.description: Creates a BatchDelete instance from paginated list results of S3 ListObjects API, preparing promises for each object to be deleted.

methods.name: fromIterator
methods.description: Creates a BatchDelete instance from a generic iterator over objects, enabling asynchronous batch deletion.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when all queued deletions are completed.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs synchronous deletion of all objects queued in the batch.
